title: Rapid-MLX is a built-in local provider in six tools
summary: Cherry Studio, alphaxiv OpenResearch, DevoxxGenie, Orchard, Homebrew, and the Hugging Face Hub docs can run models through Rapid-MLX on a Mac. The Hub path uses the local model cache, so weights do not download a second time.
